root_cause.summary: APCR1n features depend on _apc_drift_priority_active, which is set only within the proportional soft band branch that requires apc_enabled=True. APCR1n profile does NOT set enable_active_pitch_crossing=True, so the branch is never entered.

classification_reasoning: APCR1n features were designed to activate based on drift conditions (abs_error > threshold AND moving_away), but the implementation depends on _apc_drift_priority_active which is only set within a code branch that requires apc_enabled=True. Since APCR1n does not enable APC, the features never activate even though drift conditions occur frequently.
solution: Create APCR1nD with direct support-drift trigger that does NOT depend on APC state machine
